polityNote: Republic of Guinea throughout the scope. NE atoms are the 33 prefectures + Conakry (layout since 1985); the first-level units since 1994 are the seven administrative regions + Conakry, built here as unions of prefectures. NE quirk: four prefecture atoms (Boké, Faranah, Kankan, Kindia) carry the Wikidata QID of the region, not the prefecture.

sources.title: Binns, Guinea (World Bibliographical Series) — Introduction (webGuinée)
sources.says: Until 1994 Guinea had four administrative divisions; reorganized in 1994 into seven regions: Kindia, Boké, Labé, Mamou, Faranah, Kankan, N'Zérékoré.

sources.title: Prefectures of Guinea (Statoids)
sources.says: 34 prefectures grouped into seven governorates/regions and Conakry; last prefecture changes 1985 (Coyah, Koubia, Lélouma, Lola, Mandiana); 1980 Youkoukoun renamed Koundara.

sources.title: Guinée EDS 1999, chapitre 1 (DHS Program)
sources.says: Guinea is subdivided into seven administrative regions plus Conakry, made of 33 prefectures in total.

spans.dateNote: Region = union of its prefectures (NE region field, Statoids grouping, Wikidata P131). Only the year 1994 is established for the creation; prefecture limits unchanged since 1985 per Statoids.
